COLDWAR_IRQ_record_incumbent = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Ahmed Hassan al-Bakr" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_incumbent = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Saddam Hussein" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_incumbent = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Tariq Aziz" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_incumbent = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Mustafa Barzani" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_incumbent = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Idris Barzani" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_incumbent = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Masoud Barzani" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_incumbent = 2 }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_IRQ_political_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes }
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_historical_roster = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_record_incumbent = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				date > 1975.5.31
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_formed }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_formed
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ruling_party = 19 }
				}
				COLDWAR_IRQ_set_leader = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				date > 1982.10.31
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_sciri_formed }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_sciri_formed
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ruling_party = 9 }
				}
				COLDWAR_IRQ_set_leader = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_incumbent = 0 }
				OR = {
					date > 1982.10.3
					AND = {
						date > 1979.7.15
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_retained }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_alternate_succession }
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_install_baath = 1 }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_set_leader = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 6 }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						date > 1979.2.28
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_incumbent = 0 }
					}
					AND = {
						date > 1987.1.30
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_kdp_incumbent = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_install_kdp = 2 }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_set_leader = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_rikabi_dead
						has_country_leader = { name = "Fuad al-Rikabi" ruling_only = yes }
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_dukhayl_dead
						has_country_leader = { name = "Abd al-Sahib Dukhayl" ruling_only = yes }
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_subayti_dead
						has_country_leader = { name = "Muhammad Hadi al-Subayti" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			COLDWAR_IRQ_set_leader = yes
		}
	}
}
